name: Baker Cyst / Popliteal Cyst
definition: Fluid-filled distension in the popliteal region communicating with the knee joint, commonly associated with osteoarthritis, meniscal disease or inflammatory arthritis.

investigations.principle: Ultrasound can confirm cyst and assess DVT differential.
investigations.MRI: MRI evaluates intra-articular pathology when needed.

amber: Aspiration/injection or surgery is selective; ruptured cyst can mimic DVT.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Janu-pashchat shotha phenotype may be documented after vascular causes are excluded.

patientEducation.summary: Fluid-filled distension in the popliteal region communicating with the knee joint, commonly associated with osteoarthritis, meniscal disease or inflammatory arthritis.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise, locked joint or other listed red flags.
